parsed.rationale: The second participating record resides at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits inside an Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/ subtree — a sample-app directory. Per the restraint rules, any record under Examples/ triggers sample-app-mirror no-action regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The production copy of DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator.next lives in DebugPanel (Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift:195); extracting shared code to satisfy this duplicate would couple the production DebugPanel package to demonstration semantics. The duplication is intentional: the sample app replicates the display-link async iterator locally to remain self-contained without taking a dependency on DebugPanel.
